description:
Move the domain artifact and projection unit tests from the library's own issue-construction fixture to the shared one.

## Background

Shared test support (`crate::test_utils`) defines `fixture_issue(title, description)`, which drafts an issue and assigns it a random UUID. Copies with the same body still exist. The library copy is the `pub(crate)` `fixture_issue` in `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs`, called as `crate::domain::types::fixture_issue` from the unit-test modules in the footprint.

This entry covers `artifact_conformance.rs`, `artifact_classifier.rs`, `store_divergence.rs`, `artifact_directory.rs`, `projection.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The test modules in this entry's footprint call `crate::test_utils::fixture_issue`, and none calls `crate::domain::types::fixture_issue`; call sites change only their path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: Domain artifact and projection unit tests use the shared issue fixture
